notes.title: Version 1.1 Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Exciting News: New Update![/h1]

[h3]Hello, Shapeville friends!  [/h3]

We’re thrilled to share some exciting updates with you. Here’s what’s new:  

[list]

[*][h3]Match Game Achievements Made Easier![/h3]
  We heard your feedback! While everyone loves the Match Game in *Bonnie Blob in Shapeville*, the achievements were a bit too challenging. We've adjusted the required scores to make them more attainable.  

[*][h3]Subtitles Toggle Added![/h3]
  You now have the option to turn subtitles on or off for a customized experience.  

[*][h3]Improved 4:3 Monitor Support![/h3]
  For those using 4:3 monitors, we've fixed some screen issues and adjusted the camera on certain screens, so you won't miss any interactive fun.  

[*][h3]General Bug Fixes.[/h3]

[/list]

Thank you for your amazing feedback! It helps make [b]Bonnie Blob in Shapeville[/b] even more enjoyable for everyone.  

Enjoy the update!
